name: Regional Revenue Report
purpose: Compares full-year revenue and growth across sales regions and product categories

inputs.q1_revenue: Revenue for the first quarter of the financial year
inputs.q2_revenue: Revenue for the second quarter of the financial year
inputs.q3_revenue: Revenue for the third quarter of the financial year
inputs.q4_revenue: Revenue for the fourth quarter of the financial year
inputs.full_year_revenue: Revenue for the whole financial year
inputs.yoy_growth_pct: Growth in revenue compared with the year before, as a percentage
inputs.analyst_notes: Comments the analyst added to the figures
inputs.store_code: Code of the store that made the sale
